title: GraphLit: Learning Text-Enriched Dynamic Character Network Representations for Literary Study
abstract: arXiv:2605.28643v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Methods to represent literary texts as graphs or sequences of graphs mainly focus on representing character interactions, and often overlook another crucial aspect: the textual context in which characters interact. We introduce Dynamic Heterogeneous Character Networks (DHCNs), which organize long novels into temporally localized heterogeneous graphs that align characters with their textual contexts. We extract around 20,000 DHCNs from Project Gutenberg, and propose GraphLit, a self-supervised learning framework that learns rich literary representations through a masked graph autoencoder objective. Across a wide range of 12 character-related tasks, GraphLit improves over text-only, graph-only and prior hybrid baselines. translated_title: GraphLit：面向文学研究的文本增强动态人物网络表示学习
translated_abstract: 将文学文本表示为图或图序列的方法主要集中于刻画人物互动，却往往忽视另一个关键方面：人物互动所处的文本语境。我们提出动态异构人物网络（DHCN），将长篇小说组织成时间局部化的异构图，使人物与其文本语境相互对齐。我们从古腾堡计划中提取了约20,000个DHCN，并提出GraphLit——一个通过掩码图自编码器目标学习丰富文学表示的自监督学习框架。在12项与人物相关的广泛任务上，GraphLit超越了仅文本、仅图以及以往混合基线方法。针对不同动态图结构和架构组件的消融实验表明，将人物置于其文本语境之中是性能提升的主要驱动因素，同时显式编码叙事顺序和人物（特征）也（带来额外增益）。
tldr: 提出动态异构人物网络（DHCN）和自监督框架GraphLit，通过掩码图自编码器将人物与文本语境对齐来学习文学表示，在12项人物相关任务上超越仅文本、仅图及以往混合基线。
en_tdlr: GraphLit learns text-enriched dynamic character network representations via a self-supervised masked graph autoencoder that grounds characters in their textual contexts, outperforming text-only, graph-only, and prior hybrid baselines across 12 character-related tasks.
